lines.zh: 深邃之声在回响，黑暗中的低吟。
lines.en: A deep echo, a low moan in the dark.

lines.zh: 黑暗中闪烁着红眼，窥视着每一个角落。
lines.en: Red eyes gleam in the darkness, peeking everywhere.

lines.zh: 锁链在铁栅栏上摩擦，声音刺耳。
lines.en: chains scrape against the iron, a sharp sound.

lines.zh: 铁链沉重地拖行，发出闷响。
lines.en: Heavy iron links drag, making dull thuds.

lines.zh: 铁闸开启，发出嘎吱声。
lines.en: The iron gate creaks as it opens.

lines.zh: 铁链拖拽地牢石板，拖沓前行。
lines.en: Iron chains drag the dungeon stone, moving slowly.

lines.zh: 铁栅栏下摸索着前行，寻找猎物。
lines.en: Feeling around the iron bars, searching for prey.

lines.zh: 铁镣环环相扣，沉重的步伐。
lines.en: Heavy steps as the iron shackles clink together.

lines.zh: 铁链缠绕石墙，缓慢挪动身躯。
lines.en: Iron chains wrap around the stone walls, moving slowly.

lines.zh: 铁锁链在地下嘎吱作响。
lines.en: Iron chains rattle on the ground.

lines.zh: 静默中窥伺着，等待猎物上门。
lines.en: Quietly watching, waiting for prey.

lines.zh: 铁栅栏前来回踱步，无所事事。
lines.en: Wandering back and forth in front of the iron bars, idle.

lines.zh: 盯着你，似乎能看透灵魂。
lines.en: Staring at you, as if seeing through your soul.

lines.zh: 铁链缠绕，无所不在的束缚。
lines.en: Iron chains, omnipresent restraint.

lines.zh: 铁锁链沉重地悬挂着。
lines.en: Heavy iron chains hanging.

lines.zh: 铁锁链的末梢摇摆不定。
lines.en: The end of the iron chain sways uncertainly.

lines.zh: 铁栅栏内，身影孤独。
lines.en: A solitary figure inside the iron bars.

lines.zh: 铁锁链上的生锈斑点。
lines.en: Rust spots on the iron chain.

lines.zh: 铁闸紧闭，铁锁链沉默。
lines.en: The iron gate closed tight, the iron chains silent.

lines.zh: 铁链紧绷，等待时机。
lines.en: Taut iron chains, waiting for an opportunity.

lines.zh: 铁链垂着，轻轻晃了两下。
lines.en: The chain hangs and sways twice.

lines.zh: 它把指节按得咔咔作响。
lines.en: It cracks its knuckles one by one.

lines.zh: 石板上留下两道拖痕。
lines.en: Two drag marks are left on the stone floor.

lines.zh: 它用锁链末端敲着地面。
lines.en: It taps the floor with the end of its chain.

lines.zh: 黑暗中传来铁锈的味道。
lines.en: The smell of rust drifts through the dark.

lines.zh: 它一动不动，像座铁像。
lines.en: It stands motionless, like an iron idol.

lines.zh: 你就在那里，我终于找到你了。
lines.en: You're there, I finally found you.

lines.zh: 感受到你的存在，靠近些，很近了。
lines.en: I can feel your presence, get closer, very close now.

lines.zh: 你逃不掉的，我已经等得太久了。
lines.en: You can't escape, I've waited too long.

lines.zh: 你的气息，越来越近了。
lines.en: Your scent is getting closer.

lines.zh: 锁链在等待，束缚你的时刻。
lines.en: The chains wait, the moment to bind you.

lines.zh: 感受到你的恐惧，颤抖吧。
lines.en: I sense your fear, tremble.

lines.zh: 你无法逃脱我的视线。
lines.en: You can't escape my sight.

lines.zh: 铁锁链在你的四周缠绕。
lines.en: Iron chains缠绕 around you.

lines.zh: 锁链紧绷，准备行动。
lines.en: The chains are taut, ready to act.

lines.zh: 你动弹不得，被锁链束缚。
lines.en: You can't move, bound by the chains.

lines.zh: 铁栅后抬起一张阴沉的脸。
lines.en: A grim face lifts behind the iron bars.

lines.zh: 它把锁链朝你的方向松开一点。
lines.en: It lets the chain slacken a little toward you.

lines.zh: 声音嘶哑地吼叫
lines.en: raspy roar

lines.zh: 铁链拖过石板，我低吼了一声。
lines.en: Chains drag the flagstones; I let out a low growl.

lines.zh: 喉咙嘶吼
lines.en: throaty roar

lines.zh: 痛苦地嘶吼
lines.en: painful roar

lines.zh: 呻吟着嘶吼
lines.en: sighing roar

lines.zh: 嘶吼着哀嚎
lines.en: roaring wail

lines.zh: 嘶哑地哀嚎
lines.en: raspy wail

lines.zh: 发出刺耳的嘶吼
lines.en: shrill roar

lines.zh: 痛苦地咆哮
lines.en: painful bellow

lines.zh: 铁链撞在地上，泄出一声闷响。
lines.en: The chain hits the floor with a dull clang.

lines.zh: 我感受到你的弱点，即将品尝你的力量！
lines.en: I sense your weakness; you'll feel the power soon.

lines.zh: 你似乎是个有趣的猎物，但你将为你的愚蠢付出代价！
lines.en: You seem like an interesting prey, but you'll pay for your foolishness.

lines.zh: 你的贪婪使我兴奋，这将是你的末日！
lines.en: Your greed excites me; this is your end.

lines.zh: 献上你的灵魂，换取片刻的安宁！
lines.en: Offer your soul for a moment's peace.

lines.zh: 你为何如此迟疑？来吧，享受我的力量吧！
lines.en: Why hesitate? Come, taste my power.

lines.zh: 你的抵抗徒劳无功，投降吧！
lines.en: Your resistance is futile; surrender.

lines.zh: 我不会让任何东西妨碍我的计划！
lines.en: Nothing will stand in my way.

lines.zh: 你体内蕴含的力量即将觉醒！
lines.en: The power within you will awaken soon.

lines.zh: 享受最后的时光，你将被彻底消灭！
lines.en: Enjoy your last moments; you'll be utterly destroyed.

lines.zh: 你的命运已经注定，无法逃脱！
lines.en: Your fate is sealed; you cannot escape.

lines.zh: 你的力量无法伤我分毫！
lines.en: Your strength cannot harm me.

lines.zh: 你撞上的是不死之身！
lines.en: You've collided with an undying form.

lines.zh: 你撞上了我的防护！
lines.en: You hit my shield.

lines.zh: 你撞不上我，我会一直躲避！
lines.en: You can't hit me; I'll keep dodging.

lines.zh: 撞我一下，你就瘸了。
lines.en: Bump into me once and you will limp.

lines.zh: 我只允许你靠近我一次！
lines.en: You get one chance to approach me.

lines.zh: 你撞破了我的防线！
lines.en: You've broken through my defenses.

lines.zh: 你撞得太轻，没用！
lines.en: Your collision was too light to matter.

lines.zh: 别想靠近我，你永远无法击中我！
lines.en: You can't get close to me; you'll never hit me.

lines.zh: 你只能撞在我的影子上！
lines.en: You'll only hit my shadow.

lines.zh: 你将是我的伴侣，感受我的力量！
lines.en: You'll be my mate, feel my power.

lines.zh: 我的伴侣将共享我的力量！
lines.en: My partner will share my power.

lines.zh: 与我共生，共享永恒！
lines.en: Coexist with me, share eternity.

lines.zh: 你将成为我的同类，永不分离！
lines.en: You'll become my kind, forever united.

lines.zh: 感受我的灵魂，与我同在！
lines.en: Feel my soul, be with me.

lines.zh: 你将与我一起统治这片土地！
lines.en: You'll rule with me here.

lines.zh: 与我结为伴侣，共享生命！
lines.en: Mate with me and share life.

lines.zh: 你将是我的永恒伴侣！
lines.en: You'll be my eternal mate.

lines.zh: 我的伴侣将享受无尽力量！
lines.en: My mate will enjoy endless power.

lines.zh: 与我一起，创造无限可能！
lines.en: With me, create the infinite.

lines.zh: 我的身躯沉重如铅，力量之大无物可挡。
lines.en: Heavy as lead, my strength is unyielding.

lines.zh: 我的声音低沉似雷，响彻你的内心深处。
lines.en: My voice rumbles like thunder, echoing in your heart.

lines.zh: 你所携带的食物，很快就会被吞噬。
lines.en: The food you carry will soon be devoured.

lines.zh: 秘界深处，我的居所无人可及。
lines.en: In the depths of the秘界, my dwelling is beyond reach.

lines.zh: 我的外形狰狞，唯有恐惧能令你颤抖。
lines.en: My form is fearsome, only fear can make you tremble.

lines.zh: 巫师之书召唤我，你终将面对我。
lines.en: The book of the wizard called me, you will face me.

lines.zh: 我的存在是为了狩猎，这是我的天性。
lines.en: My existence is for hunting, it is my nature.

lines.zh: 你携带的食物，将是我的晚餐。
lines.en: The food you carry will be my dinner.

lines.zh: 这片土地是我的，任何靠近的人都将遭殃。
lines.en: This land is mine, any who approach will suffer.

lines.zh: 缓慢地移动，让我更容易捕捉。
lines.en: Move slowly, making me easier to catch.

lines.zh: 你已落入我的视野，逃不掉的命运。
lines.en: You are in my sight, no escape.

lines.zh: 猎物已锁定，下一刻将被撕裂。
lines.en: The prey is locked, to be torn apart next.

lines.zh: 你的身影在黑暗中显现，现在属于我。
lines.en: Your form appears in the darkness, now it belongs to me.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛注视着你，无处可逃。
lines.en: My eyes watch you, nowhere to run.

lines.zh: 你已被我盯上，无法逃脱。
lines.en: You have been targeted, there is no escape.

lines.zh: 你已被我的视线锁定，成为猎物。
lines.en: You have been locked in my sight, prey.

lines.zh: 你已无法逃避，命运将被我决定。
lines.en: You cannot escape, your fate is in my hands.

lines.zh: 我的目光锁定了你，将你置于死地。
lines.en: My gaze is locked on you, to be brought to your death.

lines.zh: 你已被我的视线捕捉，无法逃脱。
lines.en: You have been captured by my gaze, no escape.

lines.zh: 你被我的视线锁定，逃不掉的。
lines.en: You are locked by my sight, no escape.

lines.zh: 锁链尽头直指你的胸口。
lines.en: The end of the chain points at your chest.

lines.zh: 地牢的回声替你报了信。
lines.en: The dungeon's echo announces you.

lines.zh: 它终于等到有人走进来。
lines.en: At last someone has walked in.

lines.zh: 沉重的身躯转向你，慢慢来。
lines.en: Its heavy body turns toward you, slowly.

lines.zh: 它记住了你的脚步声。
lines.en: It has memorized the sound of your steps.

lines.zh: 黑暗中两点红光对准了你。
lines.en: Two red points in the dark fix on you.

lines.zh: 你一进门，它就动了。
lines.en: The moment you enter, it moves.

lines.zh: 它把铁链一圈圈绕上手臂。
lines.en: It winds the chain around its arm, loop by loop.

lines.zh: 我会享受折磨你，让你痛苦地求死。
lines.en: I will enjoy tormenting you, letting you die in agony.

lines.zh: 你将被我的力量压制，求生不得。
lines.en: You will be crushed by my strength, unable to live.

lines.zh: 我将品尝你的恐惧，你注定要死。
lines.en: I will taste your fear, you are doomed to die.

lines.zh: 我会让你的求生欲望破灭，你将死去。
lines.en: I will extinguish your desire to live, you will die.

lines.zh: 你将在我的掌控下求生若亡，注定死亡。
lines.en: You will struggle for your life in my control, destined to die.

lines.zh: 我的力量将让你窒息，你将痛苦而亡。
lines.en: My strength will suffocate you, you will die in agony.

lines.zh: 你将无力反抗，我将夺取你的生命。
lines.en: You will be unable to resist, I will take your life.

lines.zh: 我会慢慢折磨你，直到你求死不得。
lines.en: I will torture you slowly, until you are left with no choice but to die.

lines.zh: 你将被我折磨至死，无力反抗。
lines.en: You will be tortured to death, unable to resist.

lines.zh: 你的求生欲将在我面前破灭，你将死亡。
lines.en: Your desire to live will be extinguished before me, you will die.

lines.zh: 它挪动得很慢，却从不后退。
lines.en: It moves slowly, but never backs away.

lines.zh: 锁链在你脚边划出弧线。
lines.en: The chain draws an arc at your feet.

lines.zh: 铁器摩擦声越来越近。
lines.en: The rasp of iron comes closer.

lines.zh: 它把最后一节铁链甩在地上。
lines.en: It drops the last length of chain to the floor.

lines.zh: 你退到哪里，铁链就到哪里。
lines.en: Wherever you retreat, the chain follows.

lines.zh: 它留着一条路，通向你身后。
lines.en: It leaves one path open, to your back.

lines.zh: 它不急，它有过太多时间。
lines.en: It is not hurried; it has had too much time.

lines.zh: 石板在它脚下闷响。
lines.en: The flagstones thud under its feet.

lines.zh: 它抬手，铁链跟着扬起。
lines.en: It raises a hand and the chain rises with it.

lines.zh: 你听见自己的呼吸变得很响。
lines.en: You hear your own breathing grow loud.

lines.zh: 发出低吼，张开利爪！
lines.en: Growl, show claws!

lines.zh: 挥舞双臂，向你扑来！
lines.en: Swing arms, charge!

lines.zh: 张开大口，露出獠牙！
lines.en: Open mouth, show fangs!

lines.zh: 用尾巴扫向你，小心！
lines.en: Tail swipe, beware!

lines.zh: 发出嘶嘶声，逼近你！
lines.en: Sibilant hiss, closing in!

lines.zh: 挥舞魔杖，释放咒语！
lines.en: Wave wand, cast spell!

lines.zh: 将你抓起，扔向远处！
lines.en: Grab, toss away!

lines.zh: 咬向你的手臂，疼痛！
lines.en: Bite arm, pain!

lines.zh: 用魔杖射击你！
lines.en: Wand shot, dodge!

lines.zh: 扑向你，撕咬不放！
lines.en: Lunge, won't let go!

lines.zh: 铁链劈下来，砸在你肩上！
lines.en: The chain comes down on your shoulder!

lines.zh: 它用肘撞开你的防御！
lines.en: An elbow smashes through your guard!

lines.zh: 铁拳自上而下砸向地面！
lines.en: An iron fist crashes down from above!

lines.zh: 锁链缠住脚踝，把你拖近！
lines.en: The chain snags your ankle and drags you in!

lines.zh: 从阴影中缓缓现身！
lines.en: Emerge from shadows!

lines.zh: 巫师之书咒语启动！
lines.en: Book spell activates!

lines.zh: 奎密克斯祭坛启动！
lines.en: Quimix altar activates!

lines.zh: 秘界裂缝中出现！
lines.en: Crack in Nether!

lines.zh: 祭坛光芒闪烁，召唤我！
lines.en: Altar glows, calls me!

lines.zh: 从地下缓缓升起！
lines.en: Rise from ground!

lines.zh: 秘界入口现形，召唤我！
lines.en: Portal appears, call me!

lines.zh: 魔法波动，我现身！
lines.en: Magic surge, I appear!

lines.zh: 秘界中缓缓现身！
lines.en: Appear in Nether!

lines.zh: 祭坛光芒中走出！
lines.en: Walk from altar light!

lines.zh: 巫师之书的书页翻到最后一页。
lines.en: The wizard book's pages turn to the last one.

lines.zh: 祭坛的符文一个接一个亮起。
lines.en: The altar runes light one after another.

lines.zh: 铁链从地下被拖了上来。
lines.en: A chain is dragged up out of the ground.

lines.zh: 秘界的空气忽然变得稀薄。
lines.en: The air of the Arcana dimension thins.

lines.zh: 石室里多了一股铁锈味。
lines.en: A smell of rust fills the stone chamber.

lines.zh: 它站在祭坛前，像早就等在那里。
lines.en: It stands at the altar as if it had waited there.

lines.zh: 奎密克斯祭坛震了三下。
lines.en: The Quamex altar shakes three times.

lines.zh: 铁闸之后传来缓慢的脚步。
lines.en: Slow footsteps sound behind the iron gate.

lines.zh: 石板裂开，锁链先伸了出来。
lines.en: The floor splits, and the chain comes out first.

lines.zh: 召唤完成，铁影从光里走出。
lines.en: The summon ends; an iron shape steps from the light.

lines.zh: 灼烧的声音
lines.en: burning sound

lines.zh: 声音嘶哑地吼叫，摔落的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: raspy roar — and the fall makes it worse.

lines.zh: 发出低沉的咆哮，溺水的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: low growl — and the drown makes it worse.

lines.zh: 喉咙嘶吼，遭爆炸的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: throaty roar — and the explosion makes it worse.

lines.zh: 箭矢射中的声音
lines.en: arrow sound

lines.zh: 魔法爆发的声音
lines.en: magical blast

lines.zh: 饥饿的哀鸣
lines.en: starvation moan

lines.zh: 雷击的轰鸣
lines.en: lightning crack

lines.zh: 坠入虚空的哀嚎
lines.en: void scream
